entries.source_text: 我觉得我开始喜欢你了。报酬提高到事前1000，完事后4000。相信我，任务完成时，我会知道的！

entries.source_text: Okay.

entries.text: What a pity.  Are you certain you won't even hear what the job is?

entries.text: 真遗憾！这是个什么工作，你连听都不想听了？
entries.source_text: 真遗憾！这是个什么工作，你连听都不想听了？

entries.text: Yep, I'm not gonna do it.

entries.source_text: Okay, what is it?

entries.text: 好吧，那是什么？

entries.text: Then we have nothing more to discuss.
entries.source_text: Then we have nothing more to discuss.

entries.text: 那么我们没什么好说的了。
entries.source_text: 那么我们没什么好说的了。

entries.text: Exceptional job.  I believe the religious faction shall not interfere anymore.  Speak with Kane for your reward.  My thanks -- and I will certainly keep you in mind in the future.
entries.source_text: Exceptional job.  I believe the religious faction shall not interfere anymore.  Speak with Kane for your reward.  My thanks -- and I will certainly keep you in mind in the future.

entries.text: 干的不错，我相信这个教团不会再打扰我了。去和凯恩拿你的报酬。谢谢你--我不会忘了你的。
entries.source_text: 干的不错，我相信这个教团不会再打扰我了。去和凯恩拿你的报酬。谢谢你--我不会忘了你的。

entries.text: Put that down.
entries.source_text: Put that down.

entries.text: 把它放下。
entries.source_text: 把它放下。

entries.text: I am quite a patient man, but even I have limits.  Kane, teach this simpleton a lesson.
entries.source_text: I am quite a patient man, but even I have limits.  Kane, teach this simpleton a lesson.

entries.text: 我的忍耐是有限度的！凯恩，教训一下这个白痴。
entries.source_text: 我的忍耐是有限度的！凯恩，教训一下这个白痴。

entries.text: Stop that.
entries.source_text: Stop that.

entries.text: 住手！

entries.text: Be advised: I am unaccustomed to repeating myself.
entries.source_text: Be advised: I am unaccustomed to repeating myself.

entries.text: 警告你：我不喜欢重复说话。
entries.source_text: 警告你：我不喜欢重复说话。

entries.text: I will not say that again.
entries.source_text: I will not say that again.

entries.text: 我不会再说一遍。
entries.source_text: 我不会再说一遍。

entries.text: You have no need to know anything else about me.
entries.source_text: You have no need to know anything else about me.

entries.text: 你没必要知道我的事。
entries.source_text: 你没必要知道我的事。

entries.text: Most people do not bandy the name of my organization around lightly.  We control the Hub.
entries.source_text: Most people do not bandy the name of my organization around lightly.  We control the Hub.

entries.text: 大多数人可不敢随便说起我们组织的名号。我们控制着哈勃城。
entries.source_text: 大多数人可不敢随便说起我们组织的名号。我们控制着哈勃城。

entries.text: My mother, finest woman I've ever known, gave me the idea for this, the finest entertainment establishment in all the Hub.
entries.source_text: My mother, finest woman I've ever known, gave me the idea for this, the finest entertainment establishment in all the Hub.

entries.text: 我母亲，我遇到的最好的女人，是她帮我起的这个名字--整个哈勃镇上最好的娱乐设施。
entries.source_text: 我母亲，我遇到的最好的女人，是她帮我起的这个名字--整个哈勃镇上最好的娱乐设施。

entries.text: They steal from the merchants and give to the poor, or some such nonsense.  They are inconsequential to me.  That old mutant, Harold would know more.
entries.source_text: They steal from the merchants and give to the poor, or some such nonsense.  They are inconsequential to me.  That old mutant, Harold would know more.

entries.text: 他们去偷商人的钱然后分给穷人，或者其他一些毫无义意的事。他们对我来说无关紧要。那个年老的变种人哈罗德知道更多东西。
entries.source_text: 他们去偷商人的钱然后分给穷人，或者其他一些毫无义意的事。他们对我来说无关紧要。那个年老的变种人哈罗德知道更多东西。

entries.text: He's the head of the police.  Nice guy, if you like the straight arrow, honest type.  Not like his father; now there was a loyal man.
entries.source_text: He's the head of the police.  Nice guy, if you like the straight arrow, honest type.  Not like his father; now there was a loyal man.

entries.text: 他是警察的头头，如果你喜欢率直、诚恳的人，那他很不错。不像他的父亲，他很诚实。
entries.source_text: 他是警察的头头，如果你喜欢率直、诚恳的人，那他很不错。不像他的父亲，他很诚实。

entries.text: Harold's been around for some time.  He's over in Old Town.  A good source for certain types of information.
entries.source_text: Harold's been around for some time.  He's over in Old Town.  A good source for certain types of information.

entries.text: 哈罗德来这儿有一段时间，他在旧城区那里。对于某些消息他是个不错的消息源。

entries.text: 他们是最没前途的商人了，我的确是这么想的。他们卖一些零碎的破玩意。去商人集市东北角找找。

entries.text: Amusing.  He considers himself the leader of the Far Go Traders.  More of a figurehead, actually.  He knows better than to interfere with my business.

entries.text: You have no need to know anything else about me.
entries.source_text: You have no need to know anything else about me.

entries.text: 你没必要知道我的事。
entries.source_text: 你没必要知道我的事。

entries.text: Most people do not bandy the name of my organization around lightly.  We control the Hub.
entries.source_text: Most people do not bandy the name of my organization around lightly.  We control the Hub.

entries.text: 大多数人可不敢随便说起我们组织的名号。我们控制着哈勃城。
entries.source_text: 大多数人可不敢随便说起我们组织的名号。我们控制着哈勃城。

entries.text: My mother, finest woman I've ever known, gave me the idea for this, the finest entertainment establishment in all the Hub.
entries.source_text: My mother, finest woman I've ever known, gave me the idea for this, the finest entertainment establishment in all the Hub.

entries.text: 我母亲，我遇到的最好的女人，是她帮我起的这个名字--整个哈勃镇上最好的娱乐设施。
entries.source_text: 我母亲，我遇到的最好的女人，是她帮我起的这个名字--整个哈勃镇上最好的娱乐设施。

entries.text: They steal from the merchants and give to the poor, or some such nonsense.  They are inconsequential to me.  That old mutant, Harold would know more.
entries.source_text: They steal from the merchants and give to the poor, or some such nonsense.  They are inconsequential to me.  That old mutant, Harold would know more.

entries.text: 他们去偷商人的钱然后分给穷人，或者其他一些毫无义意的事。他们对我来说无关紧要。那个年老的变种人哈罗德知道更多东西。
entries.source_text: 他们去偷商人的钱然后分给穷人，或者其他一些毫无义意的事。他们对我来说无关紧要。那个年老的变种人哈罗德知道更多东西。

entries.text: He's the head of the police.  Nice guy, if you like the straight arrow, honest type.  Not like his father; now there was a loyal man.
entries.source_text: He's the head of the police.  Nice guy, if you like the straight arrow, honest type.  Not like his father; now there was a loyal man.

entries.text: 他是警察的头头，如果你喜欢率直、诚恳的人，那他很不错。不像他的父亲，他很诚实。
entries.source_text: 他是警察的头头，如果你喜欢率直、诚恳的人，那他很不错。不像他的父亲，他很诚实。

entries.text: Harold's been around for some time.  He's over in Old Town.  A good source for certain types of information.
entries.source_text: Harold's been around for some time.  He's over in Old Town.  A good source for certain types of information.

entries.text: 哈罗德来这儿有一段时间，他在旧城区那里。对于某些特定的信息他是个不错的消息源。
entries.source_text: 哈罗德来这儿有一段时间，他在旧城区那里。对于某些特定的信息他是个不错的消息源。

entries.text: They control the water.  Go to the south end of the Merchant Market, you'll find them there.
entries.source_text: They control the water.  Go to the south end of the Merchant Market, you'll find them there.

entries.text: 他们控制着供水，去商人集市的最南端，你可以在那儿找到他们。
entries.source_text: 他们控制着供水，去商人集市的最南端，你可以在那儿找到他们。

entries.text: He's the head of the Water Merchants.
entries.source_text: He's the head of the Water Merchants.

entries.text: 他是纯水商队的头头。
entries.source_text: 他是纯水商队的头头。

entries.text: They used to control the hospital until the Children took over.  Now they sit and brood in their warehouse - very strange.  You will find them at the northwest end of the Merchant Market.
entries.source_text: They used to control the hospital until the Children took over.  Now they sit and brood in their warehouse - very strange.  You will find them at the northwest end of the Merchant Market.

entries.text: 在教徒占据医院之前他们一直控制着那儿，现在他们盘踞在仓库那片地方--这很奇怪。你可以在商人集市的西北角找到他们。
entries.source_text: 在教徒占据医院之前他们一直控制着那儿，现在他们盘踞在仓库那片地方--这很奇怪。你可以在商人集市的西北角找到他们。

entries.text: He's the head of the Crimson Caravan.
entries.source_text: He's the head of the Crimson Caravan.

entries.text: 他是深红商队的头头。
entries.source_text: 他是深红商队的头头。

entries.text: They're the last of the merchants, and I mean that literally.  Small time stuff, mostly.  Look northeast of the Merchant Market.
entries.source_text: They're the last of the merchants, and I mean that literally.  Small time stuff, mostly.  Look northeast of the Merchant Market.

entries.text: 他们是最没前途的商人了，我的确是这么想的。他们卖一些零碎的破玩意。去商人集市东北角找找。
entries.source_text: 他们是最没前途的商人了，我的确是这么想的。他们卖一些零碎的破玩意。去商人集市东北角找找。

entries.text: Amusing.  He considers himself the leader of the Far Go Traders.  More of a figurehead, actually.  He knows better than to interfere with my business.
entries.source_text: Amusing.  He considers himself the leader of the Far Go Traders.  More of a figurehead, actually.  He knows better than to interfere with my business.

entries.text: 有趣，他认为自己是远行商会的头。实际上有名无实。他该知道最好别来打扰我。
entries.source_text: 有趣，他认为自己是远行商会的头。实际上有名无实。他该知道最好别来打扰我。

entries.text: She's in charge of the Weapons Store.
entries.source_text: She's in charge of the Weapons Store.

entries.text: 她掌管着武器店。
entries.source_text: 她掌管着武器店。

entries.text: Something is making the Far Go Traders' caravans disappear.  I'd like to know the cause, since it does disrupt a piece of my business.
entries.source_text: Something is making the Far Go Traders' caravans disappear.  I'd like to know the cause, since it does disrupt a piece of my business.

entries.text: 什么东西导致远行商会的商队失踪了。我想知道原因，因为这对我的生意有小点影响。
entries.source_text: 什么东西导致远行商会的商队失踪了。我想知道原因，因为这对我的生意有小点影响。

entries.text: It's in the center of town.
entries.source_text: It's in the center of town.

entries.text: 在城市中央。
entries.source_text: 在城市中央。

entries.text: Myths and legends.  The Death Claw is supposedly a ghost or something.
entries.source_text: Myths and legends.  The Death Claw is supposedly a ghost or something.

entries.text: 神话和传说。死亡爪也许是鬼魂或者什么东西。
entries.source_text: 神话和传说。死亡爪也许是鬼魂或者什么东西。

entries.text: Old Town takes up the entire east side.  The skags live there.
entries.source_text: Old Town takes up the entire east side.  The skags live there.

entries.text: 旧城区占了整个东边，那些瘾君子就住在那儿。
entries.source_text: 旧城区占了整个东边，那些瘾君子就住在那儿。

entries.text: Most merchants live there.  Simply go west from here.
entries.source_text: Most merchants live there.  Simply go west from here.

entries.text: 大部分商人都住在那儿，只要从这儿往西走就行了。
entries.source_text: 大部分商人都住在那儿，只要从这儿往西走就行了。

entries.text: An annoying organization.  Soon they may need a demonstration in the management of power.
entries.source_text: An annoying organization.  Soon they may need a demonstration in the management of power.

entries.text: 一个令讨厌的组织，也许该用个强力的手段来威慑他们一下。
entries.source_text: 一个令讨厌的组织，也许该用个强力的手段来威慑他们一下。

entries.text: Morpheus is the head of the Children of the Cathedral.  He resides down in the Boneyard.
entries.source_text: Morpheus is the head of the Children of the Cathedral.  He resides down in the Boneyard.

entries.text: 墨菲斯是大教堂教徒们的领导，他住在晒骨场。
entries.source_text: 墨菲斯是大教堂教徒们的领导，他住在晒骨场。

entries.text: She's presently the head of the Children of the Cathedral in the Hub.  I've reason to believe that may change soon.
entries.source_text: She's presently the head of the Children of the Cathedral in the Hub.  I've reason to believe that may change soon.

entries.text: 在哈勃城，她现在是大教堂教徒们的领导。我相信状况很快就会改变。
entries.source_text: 在哈勃城，她现在是大教堂教徒们的领导。我相信状况很快就会改变。

entries.text: One of the fabrications of the Children.  He's supposedly some minor deity, or something.
entries.source_text: One of the fabrications of the Children.  He's supposedly some minor deity, or something.

entries.text: 他是大教堂教徒编造的谎言，大概是个小神或什么的。
entries.source_text: 他是大教堂教徒编造的谎言，大概是个小神或什么的。

entries.text: It's a small place that sells . . . fair weapons.  Over by the Far Go Traders.
entries.source_text: It's a small place that sells . . . fair weapons.  Over by the Far Go Traders.

entries.text: 这是一个出售……好武器的小地方，由远行商队控制。
entries.source_text: 这是一个出售……好武器的小地方，由远行商队控制。

entries.text: Just out the door and to the north.  You can't miss it.
entries.source_text: Just out the door and to the north.  You can't miss it.

entries.text: 出门朝北走，你不会错过它的。
entries.source_text: 出门朝北走，你不会错过它的。
